title: cli-contract.md: name .git/lore/advisory/ as clone-local coordination state a read-only command may write
description: Found by opum-cli-e2e pass-1 qualification of lore 0.15.1 (Release run 44979100559, head 9c6b3932): lore check --json creates .git/lore/advisory/check.result.json, which 0.15.0 did not, and e2e's read-only purity row failed on it. The write is intentional: LCLI-792 / DEC-282 item 2 (#746, 809fbb83), the per-clone advisory lock and result reuse. docs/reference/cli-contract.md does not state that a read-only command may write there. Option A (recommended, pending opum-doc ruling, routed by team-lead 2026-11-22): document it. Lands AFTER the 0.15.1 tag and does not reopen it. If opum-doc rules for option B (check writes nothing when uncontended) this task is superseded by a code task.

acceptanceCriteria.text: docs/reference/cli-contract.md says that read-only means no mutation of the working tree, .lore/ or the docs bundle, and names .git/lore/advisory/ (under the git common dir) as clone-local coordination state that check and sync may write
The statement names which commands write there and the file names (the lock, the break file, <resultName>.result.json), read from src/core/advisory-lock.ts
lore check exits 0 and bun test passes on the change

implementationNotes: DEC-282 (a17), recorded under ODOC-610, relayed by team-lead 2026-11-22: opum-doc ruled option A. A tool's own coordination state under <git-common-dir>/lore/advisory/ is not authored state, so a read-only command may write it; nothing else under .git and nothing in any worktree is exempt. No lore bytes change and v0.15.1 stands. The doc change lands after 0.15.1. This text is relayed, not read from the decision record by me; cite (a17) verbatim from planning.json when writing the doc.
